summary: Example aggregate callback plugin (timer): the DOCUMENTATION block declares callback_type aggregate and a format_string option set through the callback_timer ini section or ANSIBLE_CALLBACK_TIMER_FORMAT, and the CallbackModule class sets CALLBACK_VERSION, CALLBACK_TYPE, CALLBACK_NAME and CALLBACK_NEEDS_ENABLED and records the start time in __init__.
